name: Two-Handed Tattoo (Psionic)
body:
With one’s entire body as canvas, why limit oneself to one marvelous effect at a time?

Prerequisite(s): Wild Talent or Psionic Talent, manifester level 5th. Benefit: Activating a psionic tattoo does not provoke attacks of opportunity against you, and you may activate two tattoos in the same round, as a full-round action.
